headline: A 2017 law renamed the federal building and courthouse at 719 Church Street in Nashville, Tennessee, after former senator Fred D. Thompson.
what_it_does: The law gives the federal building and United States courthouse at 719 Church Street in Nashville, Tennessee, the official name "Fred D. Thompson Federal Building and United States Courthouse." It changes only the name of the building. It does not change how the building is used, who works there, or how courts operate in it.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on June 6, 2017.
